metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.5 · 2014 · Signed, Sealed, Delivered for Christmas
metas.description: When the beloved quartet of postal detectives discover an urgent letter written to God on Christmas Eve, they delay their own plans to help a little girl whose mother's life hangs in the balance.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.6 · 2015 · Signed, Sealed, Delivered: From Paris with Love
metas.description: The Postables---Oliver, Shane, Rita, and Norman return to explore the mystery of true love as they deliver divorce papers to one couple the same day Oliver's missing wife reappears.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.7 · 2015 · Signed, Sealed, Delivered: Truth Be Told
metas.description: The POstables are on a mission to deliver a soldier's letter from Afghanistan to a teenager who's being relentlessly bullied, while Oliver's estranged father surprises him with news that shakes him to his core.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 7.9 · 2015 · Signed, Sealed, Delivered: The Impossible Dream
metas.description: The DLO postals give testimony before a closed Congressional committee regarding an American soldier missing in action and presumed dead whose daughter they met previously. At the same time Rita participates in the national Miss S...

metas.name: 5 · ★ 7.7 · 2016 · Signed, Sealed, Delivered: From the Heart
metas.description: Oliver, Shane, Rita and Norman face personal challenges following Valentine's Day.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 7.4 · 2016 · Signed, Sealed, Delivered: One in a Million
metas.description: Lead postal detective Oliver and his associate Shane have been doing a figurative dance with each other, swaying back and forth with the possibility of a relationship. Finally, on their first date at a romantic supper club, Shane begins wondering if it's a date or not, as she sees the contrast of their relationship next to the extraordinary dance performances of a couple who express the longing of her heart. As Norman and Rita work alongside each other, their personal relationship hits a bump in the road.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 8.0 · 2016 · Signed, Sealed, Delivered: Lost Without You
metas.description: A strange package containing what may be someone's bucket list shows up in a prop mailbox on a commercial set. The postal detectives attempts to track down its intended recipient.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 8.0 · 2017 · Signed, Sealed, Delivered: Higher Ground
metas.description: The postal detectives reunite a couple separated by the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 7.7 · 2017 · Signed, Sealed, Delivered: Home Again
metas.description: The Postables discover a vase with a letter inside and must find the vase's owner. The vase's origin is suspicious and the Postables will have to decide whether to do what is right or what is legal.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 7.4 · 2018 · Signed, Sealed, Delivered: The Road Less Traveled
metas.description: The Postables take a road trip in an old Winnebago in order to track down a small boy who they fear may have been kidnapped. The discovery of a 1980's era instant camera and the unusual photographs it contains, send our team on a ...

metas.name: 11 · ★ 8.2 · 2018 · Signed, Sealed, Delivered: To the Altar
metas.description: The long-awaited wedding of Norman and Rita leads the postal detectives to a letter with clues about a young woman's missing mother.
